newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China's Victor Onward 1996 net at 1.7 mln yuan.
newsitem.headline: China's Victor Onward 1996 net at 1.7 mln yuan.

text.p: China's Victor Onward Textile Industrial Co Ltd recorded net profits of 1.71 million yuan in 1996, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange said in a notice after the market closed on Tuesday.
Earnings per share were 0.01 yuan in 1996 and turnover reached 380.34 million yuan, the exchange said.
It did not specify whether the results were compiled under Chinese or international accounting standards, and gave no comparative figures.
For 1995, the company posted net profits of HK$11.69 million based on international standards.
Under Chinese standards, net profits were HK$11.80 million in 1995.
The firm proposed no dividend for 1996, the exchange said.
Trading in the company's A and B shares will be suspended on Wednesday morning and will resume in the afternoon, it said.
